mapper.sql: p.id, p.farm_id, f.farm_name, f.farm_code, p.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, p.plot_name, p.plot_code, p.crop_image, p.type, p.area, p.area_unit, p.address, p.coordinate, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.boundary_points, p.status, p.remark, p.create_time, p.update_time, pb.id AS current_batch_id, CONCAT('Batch_', LPAD(CAST(pb.id AS CHAR), GREATEST(3, CHAR_LENGTH(CAST(pb.id AS CHAR))), '0')) AS current_batch_no, pb.crop_id AS current_crop_id, c.crop_name AS current_crop_name, c.variety AS current_crop_variety, CASE WHEN pb.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.crop_image), ''), pb.crop_image, c.image_url) END AS current_crop_image, pb.planting_area AS current_planting_area, pb.area_unit AS current_planting_area_unit, pb.planted_at AS current_planted_at, pb.expected_harvest_at AS current_expected_harvest_at, pb.actual_harvest_at AS current_actual_harvest_at, gs.id AS current_growth_stage_id, gs.stage_name AS current_growth_stage_name, gs.stage_order AS current_growth_stage_order, pb.status AS current_batch_status, pb.expected_yield_amount AS current_expected_yield_amount, CASE WHEN pb.planted_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pb.planted_at), 0) END AS current_grown_days, pb.yield_amount AS current_yield_amount, pb.yield_unit AS current_yield_unit, pb.remark AS current_batch_remark

LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN `farm` f ON f.id = p.farm_id LEFT JOIN `planting_batch` pb ON pb.id = ( SELECT pb2.id FROM `planting_batch` pb2 WHERE pb2.plot_id = p.id AND pb2.status = 1 ORDER BY pb2.planted_at DESC, pb2.create_time DESC, pb2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN `crop` c ON c.id = pb.crop_id LEFT JOIN `growth_stage` gs ON gs.id = ( SELECT gs2.id FROM `growth_stage` gs2 WHERE gs2.crop_id = pb.crop_id AND gs2.status = 1 AND GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pb.planted_at), 0) >= COALESCE(gs2.start_day, 0) AND GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pb.planted_at), 0) <= COALESCE( gs2.end_day, COALESCE(gs2.start_day, 0) + gs2.duration - 1 ) ORDER BY COALESCE(gs2.start_day, 0) DESC, gs2.stage_order DESC, gs2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `plot`
user_id, farm_id, plot_name, plot_code, crop_image, type, area, area_unit, address, longitude, latitude, boundary_points, status, remark,
#{userId}, #{farmId}, #{plotName}, #{plotCode}, #{cropImage}, #{type}, #{area}, #{areaUnit}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{boundaryPoints,typeHandler=com.smart_plant.smart_plant.typehandler.PlotBoundaryPointListTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{remark},
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS plotTotalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `planting_batch` idle_pb WHERE idle_pb.plot_id = p.id AND idle_pb.status = 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS idlePlotCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crop_pb.crop_id) FROM `planting_batch` crop_pb INNER JOIN `plot` crop_plot ON crop_plot.id = crop_pb.plot_id WHERE crop_pb.status = 1 AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR crop_plot.user_id = #{userId}) ), 0) AS cropTypeCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `planting_batch` area_pb WHERE area_pb.plot_id = p.id AND area_pb.status = 1 ) THEN CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.area_unit), ''), '亩') WHEN '亩' THEN COALESCE(p.area, 0) WHEN '平方米' THEN COALESCE(p.area, 0) / 666.6666667 WHEN '㎡' THEN COALESCE(p.area, 0) / 666.6666667 WHEN 'm²' THEN COALESCE(p.area, 0) / 666.6666667 WHEN '公顷' THEN COALESCE(p.area, 0) * 15 WHEN 'ha' THEN COALESCE(p.area, 0) * 15 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) AS plantingArea, '亩' AS areaUnit FROM `plot` p
p.user_id = #{userId}
